info.title: QualityMind API
info.description:
## QualityMind: Agentic Manufacturing Quality Decision-Support Platform

QualityMind is an enterprise industrial quality intelligence system engineered for high-precision CNC manufacturing cells. It orchestrates eight specialized AI agents with deterministic statistical process control, boundary-safe tolerance verification, computer vision defect localization, 8-parameter process anomaly detection, and human-in-the-loop engineering disposition.

### Mandatory Epistemic Labeling & Audit Governance
Every finding, chart, and recommendation is strictly partitioned into one of five epistemic labels:
- **`[OBSERVED FACT]`**: Verified direct measurements from calibrated sensors and gauges.
- **`[MODEL PREDICTION]`**: Inferences from computer vision and machine learning models.
- **`[STATISTICAL FINDING]`**: 3-sigma control limits, Nelson rule trips, and capability indices.
- **`[HYPOTHESIS]`**: Causal theories generated during Root Cause Analysis (RCA) requiring physical verification.
- **`[CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE]`**: Final causal classification elevated exclusively by authenticated Quality Engineers.

### Human-in-the-Loop Decision Support
In compliance with IATF 16949 and ISO 9001, QualityMind functions exclusively as decision-support. It never autonomously releases batches, scraps parts, adjusts machine offsets, or stops production lines. All endpoints are open and accessible with zero authentication overhead.

get.summary: Run Statistical Process Control analysis and Nelson rules
get.description: Generates auto-selected control chart (I-MR), center line, UCL, LCL, Nelson rule violations, and capability metrics with DB persistence.

get.summary: Calculate process capability metrics with guardrails
get.description: Calculates process capability indices (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk) with sample size adequacy checks (insufficient-data status and numeric suppression for n < 5; prominent warning for 5 <= n < 30). Evaluates normality (Shapiro-Wilk), statistical stability (Nelson rules), process drift, and zero-variance conditions.

200.description: Calculated capability metrics or insufficient-data status with guardrails.

sufficient_sample.description: Demonstrates normal in-control dataset exceeding n >= 30 sufficiency threshold.

value.sigma_within_method: Moving Range MR-bar / d2 (d2=1.128 for n=2 consecutive differences)

cpk_ci_95.note: 95% confidence interval [1.4852, 1.9036] based on n=100 observations.

value.assessment: Capable Process (1.33 <= Cpk < 1.67) — Conforms to standard industrial quality benchmarks.
value.benchmark_source: AIAG Statistical Process Control (SPC) Reference Manual (2nd Edition) & IATF 16949:2016 Section 8.5.1
value.guidance_notice: DECISION GUIDANCE ONLY: Capability indices are statistical indicators for process improvement and supervision. QualityMind does not perform automatic lot acceptance, rejection, or quarantine decisions solely based on capability metrics without authorized quality engineering disposition.
value.future_guarantee_disclaimer: DISCLAIMER: Process capability metrics reflect historical statistical performance under observed conditions and do NOT constitute a guarantee of future zero-defect production or parts conformity.

get.summary: Statistical verification of CAPA intervention efficacy
get.description: Two-proportion z-test (or Fisher's exact test) evaluation comparing pre- and post-intervention rejection rates with statistical p-value, 95% confidence interval, machine isolation, small-sample guardrails, and anti-causal association disclaimers.

get.summary: Retrieve executive quality dashboard KPIs across 10 critical items
get.description: Returns all 10 Quality Dashboard indicators computed directly from relational SQLite/Postgres tables: (1) production batches count and status split, (2) inspection quantity (total inspected parts), (3) acceptance rate %, (4) rejection rate %, (5) active quality incidents, (6) top defect categories (Pareto), (7) machine anomalies count, (8) open CAPAs, (9) overdue CAPAs, (10) process-control status per characteristic with reason. Supports inclusive date-range filtering (start_date/end_date) and enforces sample rate sum-to-100% integrity.
